why: p02's muffled start bursting open at 0:37 and its darker breakdown with the sliding lead at 1:21 beat p12's urgent trailer ostinato that repeats one cycle five times and stops without a climax.
p03's filtered intro giving way to thumping drums at 0:13 and its uneasy late-night chord detours beat p15's gentle music-box waltz that brightens into a pastel Eb close.

p13's muffled intro, bass landing at bar 9 and drum hit at 0:42, then an 11 dB breakdown and bittersweet Dm9 second drop, give a bigger arrival and more breathing than p03's moody beat that stays level after the drums enter at 0:13.
p04's melancholy Cm loop with its 7 dB beat drop at 0:21 and 8-bar dropouts pulls in more than p14's warm summer-rooftop house vamp, whose only lift is the brief kick drop at 1:20.
p02's filter-opening burst at 0:37 and dark breakdown lead give energy and a real arrival, while p15 is a sweet swaying waltz that drifts into bright Eb major by 1:45.
p03's moody head-nod beat with the drums thumping in at 0:13 and a breakdown at 2:02 suits the listener better than p12's tense, urgent trailer ostinato looping one lament cycle.

p05's dark late-night loop landing with drums at 0:10 and a drum-dropout breakdown at 2:55 is more immersive than p11, which starts with no intro and whose bright C-major shift at 1:14 breaks the mood.
p01's dusty, moody beat with its bittersweet cadence turn at each cycle's end is preferable to p12's urgent trailer drama that repeats its ostinato without a climax.
p01's moody Bb-minor loop with the dark bII turn and D-natural colours is cooler than p14's sunny club vamp, though both stay at one level and p14 at least breathes with its 1:20 kick drop.
p11's slow moody nod with the bold tritone key change at 1:14 gives more movement than p01's three identical half-minute cycles that fade at 1:45 just as a new sound appears.
p05's dark, melancholy groove landing at 0:10 with a drum-dropout breakdown at 2:55 is exactly the cool mood the listener likes, while p15 is a gentle music-box waltz.
p13's filtered intro opening into a hard drop at 0:42 and a bittersweet second drop after the 1:26 breakdown outdo p04's one wistful loop that barely moves after its 0:21 drop-in.
p02's muffled start bursting open at 0:37 and its dark Phrygian breakdown with the singing lead beat p14's smooth, sunny house loop whose only lift is the 1:20 kick drop.

p13's drumless pickup into the drop at 0:42 and its bittersweet Dm9 lurch in the second drop give the physical arrival and breathing that p05's dark but flat 3-minute loop lacks outside its 2:55 breakdown.
p13 builds from a muffled intro to a hard drop and breakdown with a bittersweet second drop, while p01 plays the same moody cycle three times and fades at under two minutes.
p11's moody slow nod with its tritone shift at 1:14 fits the cool mood more than p02's game-level synth rush, though p02's filter burst at 0:37 gives it a stronger arrival.
p03's filtered intro opening as the drums thump in at 0:13, uneasy Bm/F detours and 2:02 breakdown pull in more than p11's beat that starts at once and brightens off-mood at 1:14.
p03's moody late-night beat with drums landing after a muffled intro at 0:13 and a stripped breakdown at 2:02 beats p14's warm summer-rooftop house vamp that stays in one place.
p01's dusty, moody beat with its dark bII turn each cycle is cooler than p15's sweet music-box waltz that drifts into bright Eb major.
p04's wistful Cm loop with the beat dropping in at 0:21 and dropouts at 8-bar edges beats p12's tense trailer ostinato repeating one lament cycle without a finish.
p13's bittersweet Dm9 second drop after the 1:26 near-silent breakdown is more immersive than p02's energetic game-style loop, though both burst open from a muffled start.
p05's dark, melancholy late-night groove with the drum-dropout breakdown at 2:55 is loved-mood territory, while p12 is urgent trailer drama pulsing at one level.
p05's dark wistful loop landing hard at 0:10 is more immersive than p14's sunny club vamp, even though p14 breathes with the kick drop at 1:20.
p04's melancholy beat with its 7 dB drop-in at 0:21 suits the listener far better than p15's gentle, swaying music-box waltz.
p04's fade-in intro leading to a full-beat drop at 0:21 and steady wistful mood beat p11, which has no intro and breaks its mood with a bright C-major shift at 1:14.
